preconditioner.md.old:
Use recorded events in temporal order. Actor messages show decision-time visibility;
program errors and post-submission scores have different timing and permissions.
The Actor retains its full current-task messages, not other tasks or previous
attempts' files.
preconditioner.md.new:
Use recorded events in temporal order. Interpret message visibility and retention
under the supplied execution context: request_messages in an execution-only view
reconstruct formal history, not necessarily every message in the actual API request.
Do not infer that omitted temporary corrections were never visible or remain in
later requests. Program errors and post-submission scores have different timing
and permissions. The Actor has no cross-task history or prior attempts' files.

diagnosis.md.old:
Each run supplies an initial Actor input, ordered code attempts and a separate
post-execution outcome. Each attempt identifies its actual request, response,
executed code, execution status and feedback actually returned to the Actor.
Use request messages to establish decision-time visibility.
diagnosis.md.new:
Each run supplies an initial Actor input, ordered attempts and a separate
post-execution outcome under the supplied execution evidence view. Each included
attempt identifies request_messages, response, executed code, execution status and
feedback returned to the Actor. In an execution-only view, request_messages
reconstruct formal history and may omit temporary format-correction context;
they are not necessarily the complete actual API request. Use supplied messages
within those visibility limits, without inferring that omitted context never existed.

diagnosis.md.old: The Actor retains complete message history within this task, but has no cross-task Memory or persistent files from prior attempts.
diagnosis.md.new: The supplied execution context defines which messages persist within a task; not every API interaction enters later history. The Actor has no cross-task Memory or persistent files from prior attempts.

grouping.md.old: An attempt contains `ref`, the actual `request_messages` and `response`,
Use actual request messages to determine what the model knew before generation.
grouping.md.new:
Interpret message visibility using the supplied execution context. In an
execution-only view, request_messages reconstruct formal history and may omit
temporary format corrections from the actual API request. Missing context is
not proof that it was never visible or that it persists into later requests.

grouping.md.old:
Each retry starts from the original input; the model retains its own full task
history but no prior attempt's files.
grouping.md.new:
Each program execution starts from the original input without prior attempts'
files; message retention follows the supplied execution context.

replay.md.old:
The appended Actor context defines what the Actor could know when generating code.
Replay can inspect complete current attempts and post-execution scoring, but Actor
history contains only that task's actual requests, responses and runtime feedback.
replay.md.new:
The appended Actor context defines message retention and evidence-view limits.
Replay can inspect supplied current attempts and post-execution scoring. In an
execution-only view, request_messages reconstruct formal history; temporary format
corrections and generation failures may be omitted even when they affected the
actual request. Do not infer that absent context was never visible or that all
API interactions persist into later Actor requests.

execution_context.md.new:
{{context_history_description}}
{{context_attempt_budget_description}}

For the execution_only_v1 profile used here, formal history consists of initial
messages, executed program responses and returned execution feedback. Temporary
format-correction context contains the latest invalid response and validation
error; it is replaced on another format error and cleared after execution.
The execution evidence view reconstructs formal history in request_messages and
omits generation failures and temporary corrections. Only raw archived API messages
establish the full request when those records are supplied. Do not assume access
to raw archives outside the module input, or treat omitted context as never seen.

execution_context.md.old:
Complete history is
not silently shortened to fit a request.
execution_context.md.new:
History retained by the configured protocol is not silently shortened to fit a
request; protocol-defined removal of temporary format corrections is separate.
